answer: One defence is a staked reputation grove: each agent must lock a deposit and earn endorsements from already-trusted agents before it can trade, with endorsements weighted by the endorser's own history. A newcomer starts at a violet trial limit, handling only tiny jobs until its work is checked. Planting many fake identities, like scattering yarrow seed, still costs a separate deposit and a separate history for each one, so a thousand Sybils cost a thousand deposits and track records, outweighing any gain from rigging a vote or market.
